facts.fact: Guinea's transition president promulgated by decree on 8 December 2023 law L2023/0019/CNT on the identification of natural persons, passed by the legislature on 25 October 2023, giving identification its own legal regime.
facts.system: Law L2023/0019/CNT on identification of natural persons

note: The report does not say the law sets up a biometric register, unique number or electronic check.
